column1: # Declaration renames of pass P8 (applications reorganization, 2026-10-31: the parameter-generic frontends and honest executions leave the ROMParams folders and namespaces — Falcon512.Native.ROMParams and MLDSA44.Native.ROMParams to GordieHowe.Falcon512, GordieHowe.MLDSA44 (shared by the native and emulated programs) and GordieHowe.Falcon512.Native, GordieHowe.MLDSA44.Native (native only); MLDSA44/Honest follows its path; gf2_256OfNat_mul_of_spread to Foundations/Fields/GF2_256.lean): old<TAB>new
